title: Anita Ward - Ring My Bell (1979 original 12″) [3IT]

lines.l: Relax, while I pull away the dishes
You and me can rock a band
You can ring my band, ring my band
You can ring my band, ring my band
You can ring my bell, ring my bell
You can ring my bell, ring my bell
The night is young and full of possibilities
Well, come on and let yourself be free
My love for you, so long I've been saving
Tonight was made for me and you
You can ring my bell, ring my bell
Maybe we can talk all night
